title: ToolMapping
description: Structured mapping of portable pstack capabilities to host-native agent harness tools and execution conventions.

file_read.description: Host primitive to read files (e.g. view_file, read_file).

file_edit.description: Host primitive to edit existing files.

file_write.description: Host primitive to create or overwrite files.

shell_run.description: Host primitive to execute terminal commands.

web_fetch.description: Host primitive to fetch remote URL content.

web_search.description: Host primitive to perform web searches.

agent_spawn.description: Host primitive to spawn child subagents (e.g. agent.spawn capability mapping).

agent_fanout.description: Host convention for parallel fanout (e.g. agent.fanout capability mapping).

agent_join.description: Host primitive to join, wait, or receive subagent output (e.g. agent.join capability mapping).

agent_message.description: Host primitive for direct inter-agent messaging.

task_background.description: Host primitive for background tasks and timers.

tool_mcp.description: Host primitive for Model Context Protocol server interaction.

plan_update.description: Host primitive or artifact convention to update task plans.

human_ask.description: Host primitive to ask user questions.
